subject: time
title: Clocks and my day
summary: Explore the parts of a day, name hours on a clock and sort everyday routines.

items.label: morning
items.fact: Morning is the early part of the day.
items.clue: The sun is coming up and a new day is starting. Which part of the day is it?

items.label: afternoon
items.clue: It is after midday and the sun is still up. Which part of the day is it?

items.label: evening
items.fact: Evening comes towards the end of the day.
items.clue: The sun is setting and the day is nearly over. Which part of the day is it?

items.label: one o'clock
items.fact: At one o'clock, the short hand points to one. The long hand points to twelve.
items.clue: The short hand points to one and the long hand points to twelve. Which clock fits?

items.label: three o'clock
items.fact: At three o'clock, the short hand points to three. The long hand points to twelve.
items.clue: The short hand points to three and the long hand points to twelve. Which clock fits?

items.label: six o'clock
items.fact: At six o'clock, the short hand points to six. The long hand points to twelve.
items.clue: The short hand points to six and the long hand points to twelve. Which clock fits?

items.label: eat breakfast
items.fact: Breakfast is often the first meal of the day.
items.clue: Which picture shows eating the first meal of the day?

items.label: play after lunch
items.fact: Playing after lunch often happens in the afternoon.
items.clue: Which picture shows playing with a ball after lunch?

items.label: get ready for bed
items.fact: Many people get ready for bed in the evening.
items.clue: Which picture shows getting ready to sleep for the night?
